description: This file defines the StaticReflectionParser class, which parses PHP source files to extract namespace, class, property, method declarations, and annotations, primarily for reflection and code analysis within the Drupal project.

classes.name: StaticReflectionParser
classes.description: A parser class that analyzes PHP source files to extract class, namespace, use statements, annotations, and inheritance details for reflection purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with a class name, a finder object, and an optional optimization flag.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the source file to extract class structure, annotations, and inheritance information.

methods.name: getParentStaticReflectionParser
methods.description: Returns a parser for the parent class if any.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name.

methods.name: getNamespaceName
methods.description: Returns the namespace of the class.

methods.name: getReflectionClass
methods.description: Returns a ReflectionClass object representing the class.

methods.name: getUseStatements
methods.description: Returns the list of 'use' statements in the source file.

methods.name: getDocComment
methods.description: Retrieves the doc comment for class, property, or method.

methods.name: getStaticReflectionParserForDeclaringClass
methods.description: Returns a parser for the class that declares a specific property or method.

methods.name: hasClassAttribute
methods.description: Checks if the class has a specific attribute.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Static method to check if an attribute exists in a list of attributes.

methods.name: fullySpecifyName
methods.description: Converts a class or property name into a fully qualified name based on use statements and namespace.
